stories.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
stories.headline: Public-service AI works best when accountability spans the full process
stories.read_scope: Complete feature: Berlin center opening, citizen-maintenance workflow, funding-document review, human decision boundary, sovereign-cloud dimensions, seaport prioritization example and vendor-demo limitation.
stories.summary: SAP's Berlin public-sector center demonstrates connected workflows rather than isolated chat. A citizen report can flow through responsibility, maintenance, procurement and finance; funding applications can be checked for completeness before an official decides; selected seaport data can be prioritized inside a sovereign environment. These are vendor demonstrations, not independently measured public-service outcomes.
stories.why_it_matters: Map one request from intake through every system, approval and final decision before adding AI. Keep source data under defined controls, show employees why information was flagged and measure accuracy and handling time without delegating public authority.
stories.image_alt_intent: Citizen request crosses intake, responsibility, maintenance, procurement and finance stages, while sovereign data controls and an accountable official gate the final public decision.

stories.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
stories.headline: Ericsson separates proven quote digitization from exploratory agent assistance
stories.read_scope: Complete case feature: framework agreements, contract-specific storefronts, digitized quote and order workflow, reported time range, exploratory agent roles, human oversight and evidence limits.
stories.summary: SAP says Ericsson digitized contract-specific product access, quotes and orders so some requests that once took days or weeks can now finish in minutes or seconds. Ericsson is separately exploring agents that assemble proposed quotes and improve catalog search, with employees retaining oversight. The reported speed change concerns the existing digital workflow, not a proven agent deployment.
stories.why_it_matters: Establish a correct digital process before introducing an agent. For one quote type, compare contract retrieval, entitlement checks, pricing, exception handling and approval time against the current workflow, while separating measured automation gains from proposed AI benefits.
stories.image_alt_intent: Contract terms, customer entitlements and catalog data feed a digital quote workflow, followed by an exploratory agent proposal and a clearly separate human commercial approval.
